tokens.npc_dota_hero_snapfire_bio:
Beatrix Snapfire and her dragon toad Mortimer are a welcome sight to the ragged folk who scratch out lives along the desert routes and oases scattered throughout Nanarak, the rain-forsaken gateway to the Outlands.

As well known for her unrivaled skills as a weaponsmith as for dispensing wisdom, mirth, and the meanest firesnap cookies the world has ever seen, Beadie's survived to a ripe old age in a young keen's trade by being quick with her wits and even quicker with her guns.

Indeed, the Outlands are littered with the bones of bandits and ne'er-do-wells who thought to take advantage of her small stature and propensity for kindness.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_snapfire_hype: Just as happy to blow your legs off with her trusty scattergun as to fill your belly up with a deliciously-dangerous cookie, Beatrix Snapfire delights in riding into battle with her dragon toad Mortimer, always ready to mow down their enemies with her homemade heavy artillery or finish them off with a steady barrage of Mortimer's firespit globs.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: With the help of a secret mixture that pairs Beadie's baking skills with her passion for black powder, these battle biscuits pack a punch.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Beatrix feeds a potent cookie to an allied unit, causing it to hop a short distance.

The affected unit stuns and damages enemy units within the landing radius.

fields.name: trait2
fields.value: Jump Distance <!-- "400/450/500/550" // do not remove these values -->

fields.name: trait3
fields.value: Jump Duration <!-- "0.431/0.484/0.538/0.592" // proportional to horizontal distance -->

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Has a different cast animation when self-casting and feeding Mortimer the cookie.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: The Firesnap Cookie now heals the affected allied unit while launching a singular, less potent Mortimer Kisses firespit to the landing destination.

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
* {{M|Doubletap}} casts the ability on Snapfire, and uses a different {{M|cast animation}}.

* Cannot be cast on the following units:
** {{M|channeling}} allied units.
** {{M|Hidden}} units.
** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
** If the ally becomes affected by the aforementioned mechanics, the {{M|projectile}} does nothing on impact.

* The {{M|projectile|x}} also does nothing to units affected by the following sources:
** {{A|Faceless Void|Chronosphere}}
** {{A|Enigma|Black Hole}}

* Applies the following ability effects on the affected unit:
** Moves the affected unit forward with a {{M|Disable|text=disabling}} {{#var:Firesnap Cookie value2}}-distance horizontal {{M|forced movement|x}} and a {{#var:Firesnap Cookie basic1}}-height {{M|Forced Movement|text=upward movement}}.
** {{M|Stun}}.
** Other units can pass below the affected unit.
** Can jump over other units and over impassable terrain.

* When interrupted, Firesnap Cookie prematurely applies the landing effects at the affected unit's current location.

* Applies the following effects centered aronud the affected allied unit upon landing:
** {{M|Trees}} within 300 radius are destroyed upon landing.

* The ability effects are applied as follows upon losing the {{Code|modifier_snapfire_firesnap_cookie_short_hop}} {{M|buff}}:
*# {{Symbol|bonus shd}} The {{M|heal}}.
*# The landing {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
*# The {{M|stun}} {{M|debuff}}.
*# {{Symbol|bonus shd}} A single {{A|Snapfire|Mortimer Kisses}} projectile correspondingly.

* {{cf|shdnotes}} Firesnap Cookie launches a {{A|Snapfire|Mortimer Kisses}} glob upon cast onto the affected allied unit's landing location.
** All Mortimer Kisses notes apply.
** The {{M|Aghanim's Shard|text=ability upgrade}} immediately update all current launched cookies.

* {{cf|shdnotes}} The affected unit now provides a non-lingering {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} 500-radius {{M|flying vision}} as it travels.

fields.value: Beadie constantly tinkers with a design she first dreamed up plotting an exodus from her old gang.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire a number of fixed-damage attacks while applying an armor reduction to the affected enemy unit.

Grants self bonus attack range for the duration.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Beatrix's mounted turret now attacks multiple targets per fire!

fields.name: buff1text
fields.value: Lil' Shredder: Attack speed increased by x and applying attack speed reduction to the target on hit.

fields.name: debuff1text
fields.value: Lil' Shredder: This unit has reduced armor.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* This ability has the following properties:
** Interrupts Snapfire's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
** Consumes an attack charge per {{M|attack point}}.
** Leveling up the ability or learning the {{ValueColor||base attack damage as damage|25tal}} {{M|talent|t=t4r|x}} does not update the current active instance.

* Grants the following bonuses upon cast:
** Bonus {{M|attack range}} based on the caster's attack range type.
** Sets Snapfire's {{M|total attack damage}} to the given absolute values. Each attack's value is now defined as:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|SetValue + [[Base Attack Damage|Base]]AtkDmg × {{#var:Lil' Shredder value6}} ({{Symbol|Talent}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Lil' Shredder value6 tal}}|tal|x}}}})

* The {{M|bonus armor}} reduction {{M|debuff}} has the following properties:
** Subsequent attacks on the same enemy unit increases the debuff stack.
*** Reapplying the debuff refreshes its duration.
** Affects the following units:
*** Allied units.
*** {{M|Buildings}}

* The ability effects are applied as follows per attack or {{Symbol|bonus t3r}} {{M|instant attack}}:
*# The {{M|bonus armor}} reduction.
*# Snapfire's attack instance.

* Recasting the ability refreshes the {{M|buff}} duration, and updates the ability values.

* {{cf|talnotes}} The {{ValueColor||multishot|20tal}} {{M|talent|t=t3r}} {{M|instant attacks}} on {{ValueColor||{{#var:Lil' Shredder type1 value2}}|20tal}} random targets within Snapfire's attack range whenever attacking with the {{M|buff}}.
** The secondary attacks have no priorities, but do not attack {{M|buildings}}.
** The {{M|instant attack|x}} component has the following properties:
*** Procs any {{M|attack modifiers}} and {{M|on-cast effects}} as per normal.
*** Do not have {{M|True Strike}}.
*** Affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Little did Beadie know when she adopted Mortimer, dragon toads--which aren't even toads at all--share more than just a name with their distant draconic cousins.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Mortimer launches a barrage of firespit globs over time while reducing Snapfire's turn rate for the duration.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
These globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit that applies a movement speed slow and damage over time.

Each glob's landing location can be targeted with an attack order.

fields.name: buff1text
fields.value: Mortimer Kisses: Delivering love one glob at a time.

fields.name: debuff1text
fields.value: Mortimer Kisses: This unit has slowed movement and is taking damage over time.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Applies the following ability effects on Snapfire while active:
*** [[Movement speed#Absolute Movement Speed|Sets]] movement speed to 0.
*** Reduces Snapfire's {{M|turn rate}} to {{calc|v1*{{Show|H|Snapfire|turnrate}}|v1={{#var:Mortimer Kisses value5}}}}.
*** {{M|Disarm}}
**** Hence, {{cf|Hotkey|A}} attack orders are considered turn orders, and sets the area-targeted direction for the next projectile launch.

* Mortimer Kisses is not a {{M|channeling}} ability, and can only be interrupted by the following sources:
** Other orders, except attack and move orders.
** {{M|Cyclone}} sources.
** {{M|Fear}} sources.
** {{M|Hex}} sources.
** {{M|Silence}} sources.
** {{M|Sleep}} sources.
** {{M|Taunt}} sources.
** {{M|Stun}} sources utilizing the {{Code|modifier_stunned}} reliably interrupt Mortimer Kisses.

* Other offensive {{M|disable}} sources (e.g. {{M|forced movement}} sources) may interrupt the ability if the disable duration is greater than the intervals between two launched {{M|projectiles|x}}.
** When affected by {{M|forced movement}} sources, the min and max launch distance is ignored if a new area-targeted location is not ordered.

* Leveling up Mortimer Kisses do not update the following ability values:
** The first damage of already launched projectiles.
** Already placed {{M|debuff}} on enemy units.
** However, the puddles applies the debuff of the current ability values to enemy units not affected.

* [[File:Dota2 Snapfire Glob.png|21px|The Glob Projectile]]
** Launches glob {{M|projectiles}} in {{#expr:{{#var:Mortimer Kisses value8}}/{{#var:Mortimer Kisses value6}} round3}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Mortimer Kisses value8}}/{{#var:Mortimer Kisses value6 tal}} round3}}|25tal}})-second intervals, starting immediately upon cast.
** Although the ability reduces Snapfire's {{M|turn rate}}, the globs are launched where the order was targeted, and do not correspond to Snapfire's current facing angle.
** Grants the following {{M|vision}} bonuses:
*** A {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Mortimer Kisses value3}}-radius {{M|flying vision}} per area-targeted location, this vision lasts until Mortimer stop launching projectiles.
*** A non-lingering {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} 500-radius {{M|flying vision|x}} as the projectiles travel.

* The ability effects are applied as follows per projectile:
*# The first {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
*# Leaves a {{#var:Mortimer Kisses type1 value5}}-second lava puddle that applies the {{M|spell damage|x}} per second {{M|debuff}}.

* [[File:Dota2 Snapfire Puddle.png|21px|The Puddle Component]]
** The puddle location can be changed with a {{cf|Hotkey|M}} move order.
** The location is marked with a red circle visible ally-only.
** Grants a 3.5-second {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} 500-radius {{M|flying vision}} at the impact location.

claims.value: Mortimer launches a barrage of firespit globs over time while reducing Snapfire's turn rate for the duration.

These globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit that applies a movement speed slow and damage over time.

Each glob's landing location can be targeted with an attack order.
Mortimer Kisses: Delivering love one glob at a time.
Mortimer Kisses: This unit has slowed movement and is taking damage over time.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Applies the following ability effects on Snapfire while active:
*** [[Movement speed#Absolute Movement Speed|Sets]] movement speed to 0.
*** Reduces Snapfire's {{M|turn rate}} to {{calc|v1*{{Show|H|Snapfire|turnrate}}|v1={{#var:Mortimer Kisses value5}}}}.
*** {{M|Disarm}}
**** Hence, {{cf|Hotkey|A}} attack orders are considered turn orders, and sets the area-targeted direction for the next projectile launch.

* Mortimer Kisses is not a {{M|channeling}} ability, and can only be interrupted by the following sources:
** Other orders, except attack and move orders.
** {{M|Cyclone}} sources.
** {{M|Fear}} sources.
** {{M|Hex}} sources.
** {{M|Silence}} sources.
** {{M|Sleep}} sources.
** {{M|Taunt}} sources.
** {{M|Stun}} sources utilizing the {{Code|modifier_stunned}} reliably interrupt Mortimer Kisses.

* Other offensive {{M|disable}} sources (e.g. {{M|forced movement}} sources) may interrupt the ability if the disable duration is greater than the intervals between two launched {{M|projectiles|x}}.
** When affected by {{M|forced movement}} sources, the min and max launch distance is ignored if a new area-targeted location is not ordered.

* Leveling up Mortimer Kisses do not update the following ability values:
** The first damage of already launched projectiles.
